title: Proving periodic solutions and branches in the 2D Swift Hohenberg PDE with hexagonal and triangular symmetry
summary: In this article, we enforce space group symmetries in Fourier series to rigorously prove the existence of smooth, periodic solutions in partial differential equations (PDEs) with hexagonal and triangular symmetries. In particular, we provide the necessary analytical and numerical tools to construct Fourier series of functions on the hexagonal lattice. This allows one to build approximate solutions that are periodic.
